settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Thoughtful defaults. Real controls. Saved automatically.
settings.transfer.title: Transfer behavior
settings.transfer.description: Choose how GetANNY starts, connects, and recovers.
settings.autoStart.title: Start new downloads immediately
settings.autoStart.description: When off, new downloads are added in a paused state.
settings.maxDownloads.title: Maximum simultaneous downloads
settings.maxDownloads.description: One queue for file, media, and torrent downloads.
settings.connections.title: Connections per file
settings.connections.description: Parallel HTTP ranges are used only when the server supports them. Applied on new or resumed transfers.
settings.resume.title: Resume paused downloads at startup
settings.resume.description: Otherwise interrupted transfers stay paused after a restart.
settings.schedule.title: Download schedule
settings.schedule.description: Times use this device’s local time. Keep GetANNY running to start queued transfers.
settings.schedule.only.title: Schedule new transfers
settings.schedule.only.description: Only start queued downloads during the daily window. Transfers already running may finish outside it.
settings.startTime.title: Start time
settings.startTime.description: The beginning of the daily start window.
settings.startTime.label: Schedule start time
settings.endTime.title: End time
settings.endTime.description: An earlier end time crosses midnight. Equal times allow starts all day.
settings.endTime.label: Schedule end time
settings.bandwidth.title: Bandwidth & recovery
settings.bandwidth.description: Limits and connection preferences apply to new or resumed transfers.
settings.speed.title: Per-download speed limit
settings.speed.description: Kilobytes per second (1 KB = 1024 bytes). 0 means unlimited. Shared across a file’s connections, not multiplied by them.
settings.timeout.title: Connection timeout
settings.timeout.description: Stop requests that are inactive for this many seconds.
settings.retries.title: Automatic retries
settings.retries.description: Retry transient HTTP failures. Authentication, invalid ranges, and disk errors require attention.
settings.retryDelay.title: Retry delay
settings.retryDelay.description: Seconds before the first retry. Subsequent retries wait proportionally longer.
settings.numberRange: {label}: enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
settings.storage.title: Files & organization
settings.storage.description: Your files stay yours. Removing history never silently deletes completed files.

settings.organize.title: Organize files by type

settings.data.title: Application data
settings.data.description: SQLite history, preferences, extension packages and diagnostics stay on this device.

browser.title: Browser integration
browser.description: Bring download links from your browser straight to your desktop.
browser.welcomeTitle: A smoother way to bring it all in.
browser.welcomeText: Connect your browser once. Send files with a right-click, or analyze a media page without copying links back and forth.
browser.previewNotice: This is a live web preview of the real download engine. Browser registration and installation require the Windows desktop application; no browser connection is being simulated.
browser.disabledNotice: Browser integration is disabled in Settings. The desktop service will reject extension requests until you enable it.
browser.detectionNote: Detection checks executable paths, not your personal browsing data. Portable installations can be located manually.
browser.verifiedNative: Verified over Native Messaging. The extension is enabled and talking to this app.
browser.verifiedWebsocket: Verified over paired WebSocket. The extension is enabled and talking to this app.
browser.threeSteps: Three straightforward steps. No silent installation, no security bypasses.
browser.step1Text: Get the compatible extension files and register the native messaging host for your Windows user.
browser.step2Title: Add the extension in your browser
browser.firefoxText: In about:debugging, choose This Firefox → Load Temporary Add-on and select manifest.json. This unsigned development install lasts until Firefox restarts. Permanent installs require a Mozilla-signed XPI.
browser.chromiumText: Open {page}, turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select the prepared folder. Approve the extension permissions.
browser.step3Text: Pin GetANNY in the browser toolbar, open its popup, and click Reconnect. A handshake, not a copied folder, is what marks a connection verified.
browser.readySend: Ready to send downloads and media pages.
browser.lastVerified: Last verified {date}. Installed or enabled state is currently unknown.
browser.unknownState: Extension installed or enabled state is unknown until it connects.
browser.altText: If a browser cannot locate its native host, use the authenticated local WebSocket fallback. In the extension’s Connection & pairing panel, select your browser and paste this key. Keep GetANNY running. Treat the key like a password.
browser.altNote: A prepared package is not an installed extension. A registered host is not proof of a connection. Helium, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera and Chromium use the shared Chromium build; Firefox has a separate manifest.
browser.prepareNotice: Extension prepared and native host registered. Browser installation still needs your approval.
browser.clipboardDenied: Clipboard access was denied. Select and copy the text manually.
